briefdescription.para: Postprocessing that is not likely to be handled in the EDG/Sage III translation.
This does all post-processing fixup and translation of the Sage III AST.

detaileddescription.para: This function was added to provide a more representative name, the post processing does not just include temporary fixes. We might make if nore explicit what function are representative of temporary fixes later (at the moment I think there are none that are temporary). This does all post-processing fixup of the AST including: 1) initialization of the parent pointers 2) fixup of instantiated template names 3) fixup of ... 4) ...
